steps.title: The Opening Question
steps.content:
So {{contact_first_name}}, how has your skin been since we set up your home routine? I usually hear one of three things. I'm still using it, and my skin looks good. Or I ran out, or the routine slipped. Or I stopped, and my skin is back to how it was. Which one is closest for you?

(Only three answers. Tap the one you hear.)

steps.title: Still Using the Routine
steps.content:
That's great to hear, {{contact_first_name}}. Your notes say you were happy with how your skin looked. Is the routine still fitting into your day?

(Let them answer.)

steps.title: Ran Out or the Routine Slipped
steps.content:
That happens, {{contact_first_name}}. Home routines can slip when life gets busy. There's no judgment. What made it harder to keep up?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Stopped and Skin Changed
steps.content:
I'm sorry, {{contact_first_name}}. Skin keeps changing after a routine stops. It's not anything you did wrong. What changed first?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Ask Permission for the Questions
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'm updating your file anyway. Can I ask a few questions about anything else you've noticed?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: The Transition: Ask Permission
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, we'll come back to the routine. First, can I ask a few quick questions so your file is current?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: The Questions: Update the File
steps.content:
(Write down every concern they name. You'll recap them in a moment.)

Would you like to get your routine back on track?

Are there products you ran out of?

Have you noticed any dryness or flaking?

Are you having any breakouts?

Has your skin been looking dull?

Have you noticed sun spots or uneven tone?

Are fine lines starting to bother you?

How about redness or sensitivity?

Have you noticed large pores or rough skin?

Would you like to get your sunscreen habit back?

Have you noticed any loosening or sagging?

(Recap what you wrote down, then ask:)

{{contact_first_name}}, of those, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: The Questions: Update the File
steps.content:
(Write down every concern they name, including the first one.)

Would you like to get your routine back on track?

Are there products you ran out of?

Have you noticed any dryness or flaking?

Are you having any breakouts?

Has your skin been looking dull?

Have you noticed sun spots or uneven tone?

Are fine lines starting to bother you?

How about redness or sensitivity?

Have you noticed large pores or rough skin?

Would you like to get your sunscreen habit back?

Have you noticed any loosening or sagging?

(Recap everything, including what they mentioned first, then ask:)

{{contact_first_name}}, between these, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Making It Real
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'd like to ask about {{main_concern}} so your file is current.

(Ask these questions in order. Pause after each.)

How long has it been bothering you, like a few weeks, or more like months?

(Let them answer.)

Is it something you notice now and then, or every time you look in the mirror?

(Let them answer.)

When it's at its worst, does it ever interfere with photos, going out, or feeling put together?

(Let them answer. Repeat back whatever they name.)

Thank you for sharing that.

steps.title: The Review
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, let me make sure I have this right.

(Recap how long, how often, and how it affects them.)

Did I get that right?

It sounds like you'd like your skin and routine to feel manageable again. Is that fair to say?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: The Recommendation
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in so {{provider_name}} can look at {{main_concern}}. We can check your skin and talk about what fits your life. Does that sound reasonable?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: They Hesitate: Find Out Why
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I don't want to assume anything. Is it the timing, or is something else holding you back?

(Stay easy. Let them answer.)

steps.title: Nothing Found: Why Did They Stop?
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'm glad your skin is doing well.

Can I ask what changed that led you to stop coming in for skin checks?

(Let them answer. Do not argue with it.)

Skin needs can change, even when a routine works well. A skin check helps keep your file current. Does that make sense?

(Wait for the yes.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in for a skin check. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Objection: “I’m using drugstore stuff now and it’s fine”
steps.content:
That's okay, {{contact_first_name}}. There's no judgment about what's on your shelf. The visit is about looking at your skin and hearing what's working.

Can we get you in for a look?

steps.title: Objection: “I didn’t see enough of a difference”
steps.content:
Thank you for telling me. We'd want to hear what you hoped would change. {{provider_name}} can look at your skin and talk it through.

(Do not promise results.)

Is there anything else on your mind?

steps.title: Objection: “The routine was too many steps”
steps.content:
That's useful to know. Your routine needs to fit your life. It's worth sharing that in person so we understand what felt like too much.

Would you be open to coming back in?

steps.title: Objection: “I’m not sure it’s worth it”
steps.content:
That's fair. A skin check gives us a chance to see what matters now. Then you can decide what feels useful for you.

Would it help to come in and talk it through first?

steps.title: If They Say: “My skin was doing fine”
steps.content:
That makes sense, {{contact_first_name}}. When skin looks good, a check can stop feeling important. Skin needs can still change over time.

Does that make sense?

(Let them answer.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in for a skin check. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: Cost or Budget
steps.content:
I understand, {{contact_first_name}}. A skin check is just a look. You're not committing to anything.

Does that seem fair?

(Let them answer.)

(Do not quote prices or sell products on the call.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: “Life got busy”
steps.content:
I hear you, {{contact_first_name}}. Life fills up, and skin checks get pushed down the list. We can work around your schedule.

Would that work?

(Let them answer.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's find a time that's easy for you. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: “I’ll come back if my skin acts up”
steps.content:
That's fair, {{contact_first_name}}. Skin needs can change before a bigger issue stands out. A check lets us see how things look now.

Does that sound right?

(Let them answer.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in for a skin check. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: They Moved or Tried Another Provider
steps.content:
That's understandable, {{contact_first_name}}. Things change. If you're nearby, we'd be glad to see you again. Your skin history is still in your file.

Would that be okay?

(Let them answer.)

Was anything else holding you back?

(If they name another reason, go back and tap it.)

Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you back on the schedule. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: Objection: “I need to think about it”
steps.content:
That's fair, {{contact_first_name}}. What part would you like to think over?

(Listen. If they name a concern, tap it below.)

A skin check lets us look and answer your questions. Then you decide what feels right.

Does that help?

steps.title: Objection: “Just send me some info”
steps.content:
I can send information, {{contact_first_name}}. A general flyer can't show what your skin needs. A visit gives you answers about your own skin.

Would a skin check work for you?
